title: CodeChallenge: A chat between Alice and Edgar

cues.en: This code challenge is a fun follow up to the previous code challenge.
cues.zh: 這個挑戰，是上一個有趣的延續。

cues.en: You are going to train the Alice and the Edgar models, and then write code to have them talk to each other.
cues.zh: 訓練 Alice、Edgar 模型，再寫程式讓它們對話。

cues.en: I can promise you that it's not going to be a very sensible conversation, but I can almost guarantee
cues.zh: 保證不會很合理，但幾乎可以保證，

cues.en: that you will enjoy it immensely and also improve your coding skills and model generation and fine tuning skills along the way.
cues.zh: 你會很享受，也增進程式、生成、微調的技能。

cues.en: Exercise one is very simple.
cues.zh: 練習一很簡單。

cues.en: You just have to copy the code from the previous code challenge and paste it into a new file.
cues.zh: 複製上一個挑戰，貼到新檔。

cues.en: Don't worry about the token frequencies or any of the evaluations.
cues.zh: 不用詞元頻率，也不用評估。

cues.en: All you need to do for exercise one here is import the models, import the text, create two optimizers,
cues.zh: 只需匯入模型、文字，建立兩個最佳化器，

cues.en: and then train the two models just like you did in the previous code challenge.
cues.zh: 再像之前訓練兩個模型。

cues.en: I will now switch to code, but only very briefly, just to review the most important parts of the code from the previous exercise.
cues.zh: 很快切到程式碼，只回顧最重要部分。

cues.en: Get some libraries.
cues.zh: 匯入函式庫。

cues.en: Here I am importing the tokenizer and the models and pushing everything to the GPU.
cues.zh: 匯入 tokenizer、模型，全部送 GPU。

cues.en: Here is where I get the two texts.
cues.zh: 取得兩份文字。

cues.en: So through the Looking Glass and the Edgar Allan Poe collection and tokenizing them, and you can see that I'm not including any of that stuff about finding the most common tokens.
cues.zh: 《鏡中奇緣》、Poe 作品集，斷詞；不再尋找最常見詞元。

cues.en: We do not need that for this code challenge.
cues.zh: 這個挑戰不需要。

cues.en: Okay, setting up the optimizers, the training parameters, uh, and then running through the training
cues.zh: 設定最佳化器、訓練參數、執行訓練；

cues.en: here is really the only exercise in this code challenge.
cues.zh: 這裡才是挑戰真正的主要練習。

cues.en: What you see here is a chat between Alice and Edgar.
cues.zh: Alice 與 Edgar 聊天。

cues.en: So let me take a moment to explain what's going on here.
cues.zh: 解釋一下。

cues.en: I started with the initial prompt of Alice saying, hello, my name is Alice.
cues.zh: 起始提示，是 Alice 說「你好，我叫愛麗絲」。

cues.en: Then I tokenized that text and fed it into the Edgar model and generated 50 new tokens.
cues.zh: 斷詞，送到 Edgar 模型，產生 50 個新詞元。

cues.en: So the output of the Edgar model was 57 tokens, the first seven of which were from Alice.
cues.zh: Edgar 輸出 57 個，前七個來自 Alice，

cues.en: The input and the next 50 were generated by this model.
cues.zh: 也就是輸入，後 50 個由模型產生。

cues.en: The 50 new tokens are shown here.
cues.zh: 這裡只顯示 50 個新詞元。

cues.en: I'm not showing the first seven tokens because that would be redundant.
cues.zh: 不顯示前七個，避免重複。

cues.en: It's literally these tokens here.
cues.zh: 就是這些。

cues.en: Okay, so then I took all 57 of those tokens and put them into the Alice model and asked the Alice model
cues.zh: 接著把全部 57 個送到 Alice，請它

cues.en: to generate 50 new tokens.
cues.zh: 產生 50 個新詞元。

cues.en: So that means that we now have 107 tokens altogether.
cues.zh: 現在總共 107 個。

cues.en: The first seven are from the initial prompt from Alice.
cues.zh: 前七個來自 Alice 最初提示。

cues.en: The next 50 are from Edgar, the Edgar model.
cues.zh: 接著 50 個來自 Edgar。

cues.en: And then we have 50 new tokens from the Alice model in response to what the Edgar model said.
cues.zh: 再有 Alice 對 Edgar 內容回應的 50 個新詞元。

cues.en: And after which you can see I just bounce this back and forth.
cues.zh: 之後不斷來回。

cues.en: This goes in a for loop.
cues.zh: 放進 for 迴圈。

cues.en: So the output of the Alice model was the input to the Edgar model and so on.
cues.zh: Alice 的輸出是 Edgar 的輸入，依此類推。

cues.en: So therefore the total length of the token vector increases each time the two models chat with each other.
cues.zh: 每次對話，整個詞元向量都變長。

cues.en: And this means that the context window for them to generate new text is always increasing.
cues.zh: 所以生成新文字所用的上下文視窗持續增加。

cues.en: Now you don't actually see that entire context window here, because I'm only printing out the newly generated tokens and not all of the previous tokens.
cues.zh: 這裡看不到完整上下文，因為只印新詞元，不印之前全部。

cues.en: Okay, so I ran through this for loop five times, which actually means ten model generations because
cues.zh: 迴圈五次，其實代表十次模型生成，因為

cues.en: each iteration in the for loop is a pair of chats from Edgar to Alice.
cues.zh: 每次迭代是 Edgar、Alice 一組。

cues.en: Okay, I hope that makes sense.
cues.zh: 希望說得通。

cues.en: If you use probabilistic sampling, you can run through the code multiple times to get a variety of results.
cues.zh: 隨機抽樣時，多跑會有不同結果。

cues.en: This one I picked because it was just great.
cues.zh: 這個特別棒，所以挑出來。

cues.en: Edgar just immediately asks, what are you, a computer and what is your opinion on the character of the paper that you were going overboard in?
cues.zh: Edgar 立刻問：「你是什麼，電腦嗎？你對那張你正走火入魔的紙，其性格有什麼看法？」

cues.en: Who are you and where is thee?
cues.zh: 「你是誰，你在哪裡？」

cues.en: This is interesting here.
cues.zh: 這裡很有趣。

cues.en: So Edgar is writing.
cues.zh: Edgar 寫：

cues.en: Where is the astounded Aston?
cues.zh: 「Where is the astounded aston……」

cues.en: And that is the end.
cues.zh: 就結束。

cues.en: That is the 50th token that Edgar said here.
cues.zh: 這是 Edgar 的第 50 個詞元。

cues.en: But then, because all of this text was then inputted directly into the Alice model, the Alice model actually finished this word.
cues.zh: 但文字直接送到 Alice，所以 Alice 接完這個字。

cues.en: So astonishment.
cues.zh: 變成 astonishment，驚訝。

cues.en: So this is not exactly the same as a chat, in the sense that these two models have not been trained
cues.zh: 所以不完全像聊天，因為兩個模型沒受過訓練，

cues.en: to understand what a chat means between two Uh, individuals to agents.
cues.zh: 理解兩個個體、代理之間的對話。

cues.en: So, uh, they're not really chatting with one another the way that you would chat with ChatGPT, for example.
cues.zh: 不像你和 ChatGPT 聊天那樣。

cues.en: But that's just because models like ChatGPT have been trained to know what a chat looks like.
cues.zh: ChatGPT 這類受過訓練，知道聊天的樣子，

cues.en: What a chat, uh, how a chat goes.
cues.zh: 知道如何進行。

cues.en: And these two models have not been trained in that way.
cues.zh: 這兩個沒有。

cues.en: They are simply completing the token sequence and generating a new token sequence based on the previous context.
cues.zh: 只是根據前文，接續、產生新的詞元序列。

cues.en: I really got a kick out of this exercise, and I hope you find some funny things in here as well.
cues.zh: 我非常喜歡這個練習，希望你也發現有趣內容。

cues.en: It is also a bit tricky to get to work, especially with keeping track of the total token count and printing out only the newly generated tokens.
cues.zh: 實作也有點棘手，尤其追蹤總詞元數，只印新詞元。
